title: Section 18, Legal Metrology Act, 2009
text: Declarations on pre-packaged commodities. No person shall manufacture, pack, sell, import, distribute, deliver, offer, expose or possess for sale any pre-packaged commodity unless such package is in such standard quantities or number and bears thereon such declarations and particulars in such manner as may be prescribed.

title: Section 36(1), Legal Metrology Act, 2009
text: Penalty for selling, etc., of non-standard packages. Whoever manufactures, packs, imports, sells, distributes, delivers or otherwise transfers, offers, exposes or possesses for sale, or causes to be sold, distributed, delivered or otherwise transferred, offered, exposed for sale any pre-packaged commodity which does not conform to the declarations on the package as provided in this Act, shall be punished with fine which may extend to twenty-five thousand rupees, for the second offence, with fine which may extend to fifty thousand rupees, and for the subsequent offence, with fine which shall not be less than fifty thousand rupees but which may extend to one lakh rupees or with imprisonment for a term which may extend to one year or with both.

title: Section 48, Legal Metrology Act, 2009
text: Compounding of offences. Any offence punishable under this Act may be compounded, either before or after the institution of the prosecution, on payment for credit to the Government of such sum as the Director or legal metrology officer may specify.

title: Rule 6(1)(a), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: The name and address of the manufacturer, or where the manufacturer is not the packer, the name and address of the manufacturer and packer and for any imported package the name and address of the importer.

title: Rule 6(1)(aa), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: The name of the country of origin or manufacture in case of imported products.

title: Rule 6(1)(b), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: The common or generic names of the commodity contained in the package.

title: Rule 6(1)(c), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: The net quantity, in terms of the standard unit of weight or measure, of the commodity contained in the package or where the commodity is packed or sold by number, the number of the commodity contained in the package.

title: Rule 6(1)(d), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: The month and year in which the commodity is manufactured or pre-packed or imported.

title: Rule 6(1)(da), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: If a package contains a commodity which may become unfit for human consumption after a period of time, the ‘best before or use by the date, month and year’.

title: Rule 6(1)(e), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: The retail sale price of the package shall clearly indicate that it is the maximum retail price inclusive of all taxes (MRP).

title: Rule 6(11), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Unit sale price must be declared on the package.

title: Rule 6(2), Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Every package shall bear the name, address, telephone number, e-mail address of the person who can be or the office which can be contacted, in case of consumer complaints.

title: Rule 7, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Principal display panel — its area, size and letter etc. Minimum height of numerals and letters based on the net quantity.

title: Rule 8, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Declaration where to appear. Mandatory declarations must be grouped together and given at one place on the principal display panel.

title: Rule 9, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Manner of declaration. Declarations must be legible, prominent, definite, plain, not obscured, and in Hindi or English.

title: Rule 18, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Provisions relating to wholesale dealer and retail dealers. No wholesale dealer or retail dealer shall sell, distribute, deliver, display or store for sale any commodity in the packaged form unless the package complies with all rules.

title: Rule 26, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Exemption in respect of certain packages. Does not apply to packages of commodities containing quantity of more than 25 kg or 25 litre excluding cement and fertilizer sold in bags up to 50 kg; packaged commodities meant for industrial consumers or institutional consumers.

title: Rule 27, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Registration of manufacturers, packers and importers. Mandatory registration with the Director or Controller.

title: Rule 32, Packaged Commodities Rules, 2011
text: Penalty for contravention of Rules. Provides general penalty for rules where specific penalty is not provided.
